'''Kako''' (Japanese: '''カコ''' ''Kako'') is a minor character who appeared in ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]''.

While on a train with [[Sylvan]], [[Shun]], and [[Taka]], Kako met {{Ash}}, {{an|Brock}}, {{an|Dawn}}, {{OBP|Shaymin|M11}}, {{OBP|Layla|M11}}, and [[Moose]]; and listened to Moose's story of how he witnessed Shaymin's flower bearing once. During this, Kako commented on how cute Shaymin was, after which Shun teased her that it might bite. Scared of this, she quickly hugged her {{p|Teddiursa}}, but Taka comforted her, saying it was alright. Shortly after, she witnessed Shaymin transform into its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Shaymin|Sky Forme}}.

Following this, the train was attacked by [[Zero]]'s {{p|Magnemite}}, {{p|Magneton}}, and {{p|Magnezone}}, but Ash, Dawn, and Shaymin were able to drive them off. She later said goodbye to Ash, his friends, and Shaymin when they set off on a ferry to Gracidea.
